atoms.a: The Zagros Mountains are the largest mountain range in West Asia, stretching across Iran, Iraq and Turkey.
atoms.sound: The Zaggrus Mountains are the largest mountain range in West Asia, stretching across Iran, Iraq and Turkey.

atoms.a: The Karun River flows down from these mountains and supplies water to 16 cities across south-western Iran.
Goat farming supports many people in the Zagros Mountains, where goats have been raised for thousands of years.
atoms.sound: Goat farming supports many people in the Zaggrus Mountains, where goats have been raised for thousands of years.

atoms.a: The mountains have also provided a home for thousands of people, with mountainside villages built directly into the rock.

instruction.text: This is the Empty Quarter in Saudi Arabia. Listen and select the correct description.

b.sound: The Empty Quarter is named for its vast dry desert with very few people, plants or animals
The Empty Quarter is named for its vast polar desert with lots of people, plants and animals
The desert has some of the tallest sand dunes in the world, reaching up to 250 metres high.
The desert has some of the deepest sand caves in the world, reaching up to 250 metres deep.
The desert is also home to huge salt flats, where thick layers of salt form across the desert.
The desert is also home to huge mud flats, where thick layers of mud form across the desert.
People and goods have been carried across the vast desert by camels for centuries.
People and goods have been carried across the vast desert by alpacas for centuries.

atoms.b: The Dead Sea borders Jordan, Israel and Palestine. Its shoreline is the ((++lowest highest)) point on land anywhere in the world at around 440 metres below sea level.

The water here is about ten times ((++saltier warmer)) than the ocean, so people can easily float on the surface. The water also contains a unique mixture of 21 ((++minerals mammals)), which attract many tourists seeking their health benefits.

However, chemical companies are ((++pumping pushing)) water out of the sea and evaporating it to extract these valuable minerals, which is causing the Dead Sea to ((++shrink grow)). Water from nearby rivers are also being diverted for drinking and farming, making the problem even worse.

hint.label: Cradle of civilisation
hint.text: Cradles of civilisation are locations where complex, urban societies first emerged without any outside influence.

atoms.text: West Asia is home to some of the world’s oldest cities as well as the world’s oldest cradle of civilisation in modern-day Iraq. The Sumerians first built settlements here over 4,000 years ago but, sadly, only some of the later sites still remain today.

Elsewhere, the ancient city of Petra in Jordan was carved into rose-red sandstone cliffs more than 2,000 years ago. Today, its remarkable architecture makes it one of the world’s most famous ancient sites.
atoms.sound: Elsewhere, the ancient city of Petra in Jordan was carved into rose-red sand stone cliffs more than 2,000 years ago. Today, its remarkable architecture makes it one of the world’s most famous ancient sites.

atoms.text: Some ancient cities, are still inhabited today. Diyarbakir in Turkey is one of the oldest continuously inhabited places in the world, with people living there since 8,000 BC, and around one million people living there today.
atoms.sound: Some ancient cities, are still inhabited today. Diyar-bakier in Turkey is one of the oldest continuously inhabited places in the world, with people living there since 8,000 BC, and around one million people living there today.
